The Facility consists of a headworks with a comminutor and bar screen; Aero-Mod treatment system with a selector tank, four aeration tanks, two clarifiers, and two aerobic sludge digesters; disc filtration; and ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection.
The disinfected effluent is then directed to a holding basin (i.e., the former chlorine contact basin) where it may be stored prior to recycling or discharge to surface water.
